description: This file defines an ErrorBoundary React component that captures runtime errors in its child components to prevent app crashes and display an error message instead.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that acts as an error boundary to catch runtime errors in its child components and display a fallback UI.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorBoundary component with a null error state.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Updates the state with the error when an error is caught.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Logs the caught error to the console.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders fallback UI when an error has occurred; otherwise, renders child components.
